scoring.caveat: Scores are initial triage hypotheses, not measured telemetry. Yaz must replace them with observed ecology/behavior data before promotion.

translation_breakpoints.name: Research evidence → CapabilityAtom
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: drop source/provenance field and ensure consumer rejects or marks UNKNOWN

translation_breakpoints.name: CapabilityAtom → Clara contract / FactoryBlueprint
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: remove acceptance/version field and ensure build packet cannot be treated as executable

translation_breakpoints.name: Design contract → Ryan executable build packet
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: omit authority/return contract and ensure Ryan cannot promote

translation_breakpoints.name: Build release → Nardole dispatchable capability
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: ship release without compatibility/evidence ref and ensure dispatch refuses

translation_breakpoints.name: DispatchEnvelope → River runtime execution
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: mutate runtime without operation/correlation and ensure effect is fenced

translation_breakpoints.name: Runtime effect → Graham durable receipt
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: return command success without readback/receipt and ensure Graham refuses durable truth

translation_breakpoints.name: Receipt/evidence → Rory ReconcileDecision
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: provide stale receipt and ensure Rory preserves UNKNOWN rather than projecting DONE

translation_breakpoints.name: ReconcileDecision → Nardole continuation/return_to
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: remove return_to and ensure continuation remains incomplete

translation_breakpoints.name: Machine truth → Amy/Agent OS/Linear/GWS human projection
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: inject stale/conflicting source and ensure human projection shows provenance/freshness conflict

translation_breakpoints.name: Yaz observation → memory/reclassification/next CapabilityNeed
translation_breakpoints.negative_test: emit anomaly outside current schema and ensure raw observation survives classification

weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: fresh capability/health receipt proving the advertised capability, not process presence alone
fresh claim + runtime binding + heartbeat/lease + WorkGraph correlation

weak_proof_zones.claim: PR merged treated as capability shipped
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: post-merge load/deploy/use receipt from the consuming environment

weak_proof_zones.claim: Tests PASS treated as real-world effect
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: real operational effect/readback that can falsify the internal test result

weak_proof_zones.claim: API 200 treated as external mutation success
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: semantic mutation receipt or authoritative readback beyond HTTP transport success

weak_proof_zones.claim: GWS/SaaS command sent without effect receipt
Agent identity inferred from active harness session
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: EmbodiedHolon binding: institutional identity + embodiment + runtime + authority scope

weak_proof_zones.claim: Linear status treated as runtime truth
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: reconciled WorkGraph/effect evidence; Linear remains a projection rather than runtime truth

weak_proof_zones.claim: Supabase row treated as freshest truth without observed_at/freshness
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: source + observed_at + freshness policy + evidence_ref; stale rows render STALE/UNKNOWN

weak_proof_zones.claim: Design/ADR/spec completion treated as operational maturity
weak_proof_zones.stronger_proof_required: post-promotion operational canary and observation window, not document completion

next_gate.instruction: Do not launch five build projects. Populate the 10 translation contracts and 10 stronger-proof requirements from current durable evidence; then choose at most 1–2 smallest gaps for implementation.
next_gate.preferred_vertical_slice: CG1 + CG2 intersection: Truth/Provenance envelope at one translation breakpoint that currently requires A0/manual interpretation.
